scripts.dev: npm run db:generate && npm run db:sync && npm run db:backfill-personal && concurrently "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix website run dev"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix website install && npm --prefix website run build
scripts.db:generate: prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix backend exec prisma generate -- --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix website install
